title: Zesty Middle Eastern Milk Fattoush
description: A creamy and tangy Middle Eastern salad featuring milk, nuka-pickle, and toasted pita bread, perfect for a crowd-pleasing snack or light lunch. This egg-free friendly dish is a unique twist on traditional fattoush.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Toss the pita bread with 2 tablespoons of olive oil and toast in the oven for 10 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
In a large bowl, whisk together the milk, sumac, salt, and black pepper.
Add the diced nuka-pickle, cucumber, tomato, and red onion to the bowl and stir to combine.
Add the toasted pita bread to the bowl and toss to combine with the milk mixture.
Drizzle the remaining 2 tablespoons of olive oil over the top of the salad and toss again to combine.
Chill the salad in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Serve the salad cold, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
